signin.title: Sign in

flow.heading: Checkout
flow.cardSub: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay · on the Bank of Georgia page
flow.storeSub: This store doesn't take card payments online yet. Your order is placed now, and the store will arrange payment with you.

flow.agreePay: By paying you agree to the store's <rules>return rules</rules>
flow.agreeOrder: By ordering you agree to the store's <rules>return rules</rules>
flow.placeError: The order could not be placed. Please try again.

payReturn.checkingBody: This takes a few seconds — please keep this page open.
payReturn.failedTitle: The payment did not go through
payReturn.failedBody: The bank declined the payment or it was interrupted. You were not charged, and your bag is saved.
payReturn.failedBodyNoBag: The bank declined the payment or it was interrupted. You were not charged.
payReturn.slowTitle: We can't confirm the payment yet
payReturn.slowBody: The bank hasn't answered yet. If you were charged, the order will show as paid in your orders — don't pay again.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyBody: Your orders will show here after checkout.
orders.heading: Your orders
orders.signInRequired: Sign in to view your orders.
orders.emptyTabSub: Switch tab to see your other orders.

orderDetail.title: Order #{{number}}
orderDetail.notFoundBody: This order does not exist, or it is not on your account.

status.refund_pending: Your money is on its way back

sub.placed: The store is preparing your order.

sub.refund_pending: The bank is confirming it, usually within 3–5 working days

step.refundDone: The money is on your card

orderDetail.courierCalls: The courier will call you before arriving
orderDetail.refundEmail: You'll get a confirmation by email
orderDetail.cancelledByStore: The store cancelled the order. We are sorry.
orderDetail.cardSubPending: The money is going back to this card
orderDetail.cancelBody: You can cancel while the store has not started preparing it. Once it ships, contact the store instead.

success.title: Thank you, {{name}}!
success.body: Order <num>#{{number}}</num> is in. You'll get a confirmation by SMS and email.
success.payLaterSub: The store will arrange the payment with you.
success.note: Your esy account works in every esy store: all your orders in one place.

personal.required: Name, surname and date of birth are required.
personal.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
personal.emailHint: It comes from your Google account and cannot be changed here.
personal.phoneSub: Order notices and codes come to this number
personal.newNumber: New number. The current one stays active until you confirm the new one.

profileGate.title: Tell us about you
profileGate.subtitle: Fill it in once and it works in every esy store.
profileGate.dobHint: The store can't see your date of birth. It's needed for age-restricted items.
profileGate.required: Please fill in your name, surname and date of birth.
profileGate.error: Could not save. Please try again.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.addPrompt: Add a phone number to verify it before checkout.
phone.sentHint: We sent a 4-digit code to your phone.

about.title: About
about.deliveryNote: Delivery is charged once per order and shown again before you pay.

variant.struckAlone: Struck through — not available right now.
variant.priceForCombination: This price is for the combination you picked.

closed.title: This store is unavailable
closed.body: {{domain}} is suspended for now, so nothing can be bought here. Orders you've already placed are in your esy account.

phoneGate.title: Phone number
phoneGate.subtitle: We'll text you a 4-digit code. Your number is how you hear about your order, and how the courier reaches you.
phoneGate.existingSubtitle: Every esy account now needs a verified phone. Your orders, addresses and shops are all still here — verify your number to carry on.
phoneGate.oneNumber: One number belongs to one account. You can change it later in your account settings.
phoneGate.codeSentPlain: We sent the code to your phone.
phoneGate.codeHint: The code works for 10 minutes. No SMS? Check the number, or wait and send it again.
phoneGate.wrong_one: That code is wrong. {{count}} try left.
phoneGate.wrong_other: That code is wrong. {{count}} tries left.
phoneGate.takenSub: One number belongs to one account.
phoneGate.taken: This number is already on another esy account. Sign in with that account, or enter another number.
phoneGate.lockedBody: Too many wrong codes. To protect your account, entering codes is paused for a while.
phoneGate.lockedWait: You can ask for a new code in <num>{{time}}</num>.

errors.PHONE_INVALID: That number does not look right — 9 digits, starting with 5.
errors.PHONE_TAKEN: This number is already verified on another esy account.
errors.PHONE_COOLDOWN: Please wait a moment before asking for another code.
errors.PHONE_CAP: Too many codes sent to this number today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.SMS_UNAVAILABLE: The code could not be sent right now. Your number is kept — try again in a minute.
errors.CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.CODE_WRONG: Incorrect code — check it and try again.
errors.CODE_LOCKED: Five wrong codes — this code has been cancelled. Ask for a new one.
errors.PHONE_REQUIRED: Verify your phone number to continue.
errors.PHONE_CHANGE_NEEDS_CODE: Confirm the new number with a code — the current one stays until then.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
